player_prompt.intro:
Tiririt da Minesweeper.
Inagrawen n wurar d asɣell-nsen i meṛṛa yicellen ur nelli d imiḍanen.
Akken ad texdem ṛṛay, ṣṣafeḍ kan tiɣzi d tiɣmert n yicelli i tebɣit ad tessɣel s tsefḍa-agi:
- `[row col]`: Ssɣel icelli deg tiɣzi d tiɣmert i d-ibeddel.
Amedya:
- `[3 2]` ad tessɣel icelli deg tiɣzi 3, tiɣmert 2.
- `[5 6]` ad tessɣel icelli deg tiɣzi 5, tiɣmert 6.
Deg ṛṛay amenzu, ad tessɣel tamnaḍt i zdat n yicelli i tebɣit ad d-tessɣel i wakken ad tili d aɣellis.
Talɣa n yicella tura d-tid s ddaw-a. Icellen ur nettwassɣelen d-tenfella s yitri (.), izwilen i ssɣelen d-rnan-d s wuṭṭun n imiḍanen i zdat.
Ur teddil ara ad texdem ṛṛay i yicellen i yellan ssɣelen.
Talɣa n yicella tura d-tid s ddaw-a:

invalid_move.wrong_format: Ur d-terriḍ ara s tdukliwin i yellan deg teẓgi n yiberdan.
invalid_move.out_of_bounds: Tiɣriwin n tseddarin d tzelɣa ur llint ara deg uzal.

outcome.win: Ayyuz, tessawḍeḍ ad tesnefliḍ tablat n Minesweeper.
outcome.turn_limit: Tessaweḍ-d tezmert n tuɣalin. Tewwḍeḍ s rrbeḥ {percent}% seg yiḥeddaden isegmanen.
